summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 29, 2026, containing its Notice of Convocation of the 24th Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders and the Business Report for the 24th fiscal year. This is a routine annual general meeting (AGM) disclosure required of a foreign private issuer, providing customary agenda items and financial reports. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is indicated. The filing is a standard reporting obligation with no extraordinary corporate action. Thus, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
